summary: Add local PostgreSQL services, explicit schema migrations and a private database for each test file cloned from a migrated template.
description: Add local Postgres development and test services, SQLAlchemy/Alembic integration for the FastAPI service (python-api, alone or as the backend of python-react), and explicit migration commands. The test harness clones a migrated template so each test file has a private database. Readiness checks distinguish API health from database availability. Product tables, queries and access rules are your work. Production hosting is separate, and migrations run as a release step rather than at application startup.
seoDescription: Postgres for FastAPI projects, with Docker Compose, SQLAlchemy, Alembic migrations and isolated databases for integration tests.

projectExamples.title: Persistent inventory workbench
projectExamples.description: An inventory workbench where staff enter equipment records in a React interface and retrieve them from a Python API backed by Postgres.

projectExamples.title: Import review database
projectExamples.description: An import review API that saves incoming rows and reviewers' decisions in Postgres, so reviewers can retrieve earlier results and continue their work.

plain.whatItIs: Adds PostgreSQL storage to Python web apps and APIs, with local test databases and saved steps for table changes.
goodAt: Running the database on your own computer for development and tests
Making table changes through reviewed, saved steps
Giving each test file its own ready-made copy of the database
notGoodAt: Hosting a live production database; arrange a hosting provider separately.

requests: give my backend a local SQL database with persistent development data
isolate each test file's database without rebuilding its schema every time
manage schema changes through migrations and check them against my models
run a separate fast database service for tests
